stem: An enterprise runs a generative AI (GenAI) document summarization workload in a dedicated application AWS account using Amazon Bedrock. stem: A company operates a global e-learning marketplace that helps learners discover courses and instructors. The platform has 40 million monthly active users and manages a catalog of 15 million courses and 150 million learner reviews currently stored in a PostgreSQL database. Which solution satisfies these requirements with the lowest development effort?
